title: CogRSI: Evolving and Auditing Cognitive Reasoning Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2611.01113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a language model learn better ways to reason about other people's minds by improving its own strategies, and are the strategies it learns actually right? We study this with cogrsi. A grounded reader marks who saw each event in a story and uses a short written principle to settle disagreements between its readings. With a principle written by experts, it beats self-consistency at the same token cost. A self-improvement loop then writes the principle itself. It keeps an update only if accuracy rises by a calibrated margin, and in one variant only if it also passes counterfactual test pairs. The learned principles transfer: on 800 BigToM pairs that no system had seen, each of them scores higher than the expert principle. We then check what the learned rules actually say. Each rule is translated into code and run on thousands of small stories with known answers. Most of them give a wrong answer in at least one situation they claim to cov

translated_title: CogRSI：认知推理策略的演化与审计
translated_abstract: 语言模型能否通过改进自身策略来学习更好地理解他人心理的推理方式？它学到的策略是否真的正确？我们通过CogRSI来研究这个问题。一个基于证据的阅读器标记故事中每个事件是被谁看到的，并使用一条简短的书面原则来解决多次阅读之间的分歧。在使用专家撰写的原则时，它在相同token成本下优于自洽性方法。随后，自我改进循环自己撰写该原则，只有当准确率以校准后的幅度提升时才保留更新，其中一个变体还要求通过反事实测试对才会保留。学到的原则具有可迁移性：在800个任何系统都未见过的BigToM数据对上，每条原则的得分都高于专家原则。接着我们检验这些学到的规则的实际含义：每条规则被翻译成代码，并在数千个答案已知的小故事上运行。大多数规则在至少一个其声称覆盖的情境中给出了错误答案。
tldr: 本文提出CogRSI框架，让语言模型通过自我改进循环自动撰写并优化心理理论推理原则，并创新性地将学到的规则翻译成代码在可控测试故事上进行审计，发现多数自我改进得到的规则在其声称覆盖的情境中仍会出错。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CogRSI, a framework that lets language models self-improve theory-of-mind reasoning principles through a self-improvement loop, and innovatively audits the learned rules by translating them into code and testing on controlled stories, revealing that most self-improved rules fail in at least one situation they claim to cover.
